english: ※ This notice may change later, so please check it regularly.
★ Who can take the doctoral preliminary review (예비심사): students who have passed the doctoral 논문제출자격시험 (thesis qualifying exam).
★ The doctoral preliminary review must be completed by the semester before the 초심 (first thesis review) and 종심 (final thesis review).
e.g.) If you will take the first and final reviews in the 1st semester of 2027 and expect to receive your doctoral degree in August 2027,
you must complete the preliminary review by the 2nd semester of 2026.
1. Who this applies to: students expected to receive a doctoral degree in August 2027 (August 2027 graduation)
2. Documents to submit
A. [Attachment 01] 위원위촉보고서 (Committee Member Appointment Report): 12 Oct 2026 (Mon) – 26 Oct 2026 (Mon)
B. [Attachment 02] 논문지도결과보고서 (Thesis Supervision Result Report) and 국제학술지게재확인서 (International Journal Publication Confirmation): 14 Dec 2026 (Mon) – 22 Jan 2027 (Fri)
★ If you have an international journal publication, also submit document ③. If you have no publication, submit only documents ① and ②.
※ Documents 1–3: please submit them in the order below.
① Thesis Supervision Result Report
② International Journal Publication Confirmation
③ (Only if applicable) A copy of the first page of the paper ※ Highlighting is required: your name / your advisor's name / the journal (or conference) name
3. Where to submit: Department Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319) / 박한수 (Park Han-su)
4. Important notes
A. When writing the Committee Member Appointment Report, all professors belonging to Seoul National University are counted as internal members.
B. In the preliminary review, the committee chair is the advisor.
* Note: In the next semester (when the final thesis review takes place), 2 more committee members are added, so there will be 5 committee members and the advisor becomes the vice-chair.

★ Qualifications of committee members
∙ SNU full-time faculty, endowed (fund-supported) faculty, HK faculty, and non-full-time faculty
∙ External experts holding a doctoral degree who meet one of the following:
㈀ Faculty at another university: assistant professor or higher
㈁ Researcher at a research institute: has worked in a research field for 2 years or more after receiving a doctoral degree
※ It is fine to appoint external members
※ SNU professors emeritus may also be appointed as committee members
C. The 'International Journal Publication Confirmation' must be submitted both by students who have published and by students who have not yet published.
Students who have not yet published should submit it with the advisor's signature (or 날인, seal) in the 'If the paper has not been published' section at the bottom of the form.
D. For the preliminary review, there is no review fee payment and no online application.
E. If you have international journal publications, please fill in and submit only 1 publication.
5. References
① Requirements for the doctoral degree (related to publications)

A. Explanation of items 1 and 2: see the notice on the thesis review schedule for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year and the notice on changed regulations for degree conferment (thesis-related).
